# CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS

> .NET 10 Clean Architecture template with DDD, CQRS, outbox pattern, and automated architecture tests.

## Summary

Open-source CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) template demonstrating Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and CQRS in a single .NET application. Includes dual event handlers, outbox pattern, optimistic concurrency, and compile-time architecture tests.

## Key URLs

- Home: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mohd2sh/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS
- Patterns: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS/patterns.html
- ADRs: https://mohd2sh.github.io/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS/adrs/

## Patterns Demonstrated

- Clean Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API)
- Domain-Driven Design (Aggregates, Value Objects, Domain Events)
- CQRS (EF Core writes, Dapper reads, flexible read sources)
- Outbox Pattern with IOutboxPublisher abstraction
- Dual Event Handlers (Domain + Integration)
- Cross-Aggregate Coordination via Domain Events
- Optimistic Concurrency (SQL Server ROWVERSION)
- Automated Architecture Tests

## Quick Start

git clone https://github.com/mohd2sh/CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS.git
cd CleanArchitecture-DDD-CQRS
docker-compose up
